# Grounded by live API capture captures/20260610T200935Z-api_conditions_matrix_aapl.
# server_version=200, events.jsonl sha256 prefix: 87059663ed139026.
# Replays the order-conditions matrix (AORD-004) observed on 2026-06-10 against
# live paper Gateway after the contract-bound condition field-order fix: all six
# condition families (price=1, time=3, margin=4, execution=5, volume=6,
# percent_change=7) were accepted on far-from-market LMT BUY 100 AAPL orders and
# reached PreSubmitted. Each order then received the off-hours code-399 deferral
# warning ("will not be placed at the exchange until 2026-06-11 09:30:00
# US/Eastern"), which closes the order handle before the cancel acknowledgement
# (order_status Cancelled + code 202) arrives; the Gateway re-emits the
# PreSubmitted open_order/order_status pair several times around the warning.
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to DU9000001, perm ids ->
# 900356-900361, order ref -> ibkrgo-sanitized-20260610T200935Z-001, submitter
# string dropped. Trimmed: farm-status 2104/2107/2158, the driver's quote-anchor
# market-data exchange, its safety global cancels, and the trailing code-161
# responses to the final global cancel.
# The live conditioned open_order echoes carried normalized condition values
# (price 2918.10, time rendered as "20260610 16:11:37 US/Eastern", execution
# exchange echoed as ANY); since the None-sentinel fix they decode fully and
# are frozen by capture-decode tests on the raw frames. The open_order lines
# here carry the base shape curated at promotion time; the condition wire
# shape is pinned on the client place_order lines below.
